Friend of the snails!

14,000 teethIts tongue is like sandpaper full of tiny teeth.

Snails help the garden: they clean up old leaves and fungi. If you see one, let it pass: never put salt on it!

Real sounds: hedgehog (Ullus, Wikimedia Commons, CC0); song thrush (Benoît Van Hecke, xeno-canto XC541754, CC BY-SA 4.0); rain (ezwa, Wikimedia Commons, public domain). The snail's glide, the foam and the hedgehog's sneeze are synthesized sounds. Realistic images made with AI.
